notes.note: COTRTLIC transfers to the add/update program with XCTL PROGRAM(LIT-ADDTPGM), whose VALUE is 'COTRTUPC'; it re-enters itself with RETURN TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID), VALUE 'CTLI'.

COTRTUPC re-enters itself with RETURN TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID), VALUE 'CTTU'; its XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) target is LIT-ADMINPGM ('COADM01C', not in this module) or the calling program carried in the commarea, which stays an open ask.

closures.how: the symbolic map copybook COTRTLI is in the module's cpy-bms root, so the screen fields and their COBOL names are known without the BMS macro source
